children: Champions Oncology reported first quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $15.2 million, an 8.8% increase year-over-year, and adjusted EBITDA of $671,000 versus $59,000 in the prior-year quarter. The company noted an oncology services margin improvement to 51% from 43%, driven by higher core research services conversion and lower third-party radiolabeling costs. Net loss narrowed slightly to $426,000 for the quarter and the company ended the period with approximately $4.4 million in cash and no debt.
Revenue: $15.2 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026 (up 8.8% year-over-year).
Oncology services margin (Non-GAAP): 51% for Q1 FY2027, up from 43% in the prior-year period.
Adjusted EBITDA (Non-GAAP): $671,000 for Q1 FY2027, compared with $59,000 in Q1 FY2026.
Net loss (GAAP): $426,000 for the quarter, versus a net loss of $466,000 in the prior-year quarter.
Cash and cash equivalents: $4.4 million as of July 31, 2026; no debt.
Growth driven primarily by higher core research services revenue through improved conversion of contracted work into recognized revenue.
Increased commercial activity around the company's data offerings, with efforts to broaden data licensing across a larger customer base.
Continued investments in expanding the commercial organization, radiopharmaceutical capabilities, data platform, and target discovery initiatives (Corellia subsidiary).
Operational cost improvements included lower third-party radiolabeling costs contributing to the improved oncology services margin.
Deferred revenue increased to $9.6 million as of July 31, 2026, supporting near-term contracted work conversion.
